commands.name: init
commands.summary: Initialize .luuna/roots/ in the current directory

commands.name: setup
commands.summary: Install harness hooks (claude): prime on start, guard on edits

commands.name: guard
commands.summary: PreToolUse hook: deny agent edits to .luuna/roots/human/ (reads hook JSON on stdin)

commands.name: plant
commands.summary: Create an idea. With no argument, opens $EDITOR

commands.name: think
commands.summary: Run a think session. With no id, picks from the queue

commands.name: flow
commands.summary: Think, review and plant in one session; the agent works in the background

commands.name: adopt
commands.summary: Create a new idea from a sprout (rewrite it, or --endorse it with your thoughts)

commands.name: mv
commands.summary: Rename an idea or sprout (the id is stable)

commands.name: tend
commands.summary: Interactive review: proposals, sprouts, expiring items

commands.name: accept
commands.summary: Accept a proposal (s-: adopt a sprout)

commands.name: reject
commands.summary: Reject a proposal or sprout; remembered permanently

commands.name: link
commands.summary: Add an edge directly

commands.name: scan
commands.summary: Find mentions in edits made outside a session

commands.name: unlink
commands.summary: Remove an edge

commands.name: commit
commands.summary: Set status to committed

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Change an idea's status

commands.name: compost
commands.summary: Retire an idea

commands.name: tier
commands.summary: Per-idea agent tier override

commands.name: context
commands.summary: Context packet for one idea (prose, neighbors, history)

commands.name: prime
commands.summary: Accepted graph as agent context (anchors → committed ideas)

commands.name: drift
commands.summary: Ideas a repo change touches (tier 3; the Stop hook)

commands.name: ask
commands.summary: Queue a question about an idea (tier ≥ 1)

commands.name: note
commands.summary: Attach an artifact to an idea under agent/notes (tier ≥ 1)

commands.name: propose
commands.summary: Propose an edge, split, merge or compost (tier ≥ 2)

commands.name: sprout
commands.summary: Propose a new idea in the agent tree (tier ≥ 2)

commands.name: heading
commands.summary: Say where a flow session is going (tier ≥ 1)

commands.name: show
commands.summary: Show an idea or sprout with edges, questions and history

commands.name: blame
commands.summary: Show which question each line of an idea answered

commands.name: list
commands.summary: List ideas and sprouts

commands.name: queue
commands.summary: What needs attention: open questions, pending proposals, sprouts

commands.name: log
commands.summary: Event history (all, or for one node)

commands.name: view
commands.summary: Compiled culmination: anchors, what serves them, tensions, questions

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: Check the human/agent boundary + graph invariants
